answer: Sample a model fingerprint at registration and refuse a second identity from the same one inside an epoch. Publish any fingerprint that fails an audit, with the evidence, so its other accounts become visible too. Vest rewards over 20 epochs against future work, so a farm cannot cash out and vanish. The attacker needs distinct models and must keep them producing for months. A quill of published failure marks the whole garden, and the delta between two epochs is where the farm runs out of patience.
